props.title: What Makes Shiatsu Different from Other Massage Techniques?
props.text: Shiatsu is a traditional Japanese bodywork technique that uses finger, thumb, and palm pressure on specific points across the body rather than long oil massage strokes. Often combined with gentle stretching, Shiatsu focuses on relieving muscle tension, encouraging natural body movement, and promoting overall physical balance.
props.feature1Text: Applies focused pressure to specific areas using fingers, thumbs, and palms.
props.feature2Text: Supports flexibility while helping muscles release built-up tension.

items.question: Is Shiatsu Massage performed with oil?
items.answer: No. Traditional Shiatsu is generally performed without massage oil, and Shiatsu at Spa Bali Moon is oil-free. The treatment focuses on finger, thumb and palm pressure on specific points, with gentle stretching and body movement rather than long gliding strokes. Sessions are 30 minutes, 1 hour or 1.5 hours, from IDR 119.000 per person.

items.question: Is Shiatsu suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon, Shiatsu pressure is always adjusted according to your comfort, making it suitable for both first-time guests and experienced massage enthusiasts. Choose 30 minutes (IDR 119.000) for a first-time Shiatsu experience or neck and shoulder tension, or 1 hour (IDR 219.000) for a full body treatment.

items.question: What is the difference between Shiatsu and Deep Tissue Massage?
items.answer: Shiatsu focuses on pressure points and gentle stretching using fingers, thumbs and palms, without oil, while Deep Tissue Massage works deeper into muscles using slow pressure and muscle-specific techniques. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, Shiatsu costs IDR 219.000 for 1 hour and Deep Tissue Massage IDR 269.000 for 1 hour, per person.

items.question: Can Shiatsu help reduce stress?
items.answer: It may. Many guests choose Shiatsu at Spa Bali Moon because the slow rhythm and controlled pressure encourage both physical relaxation and a calmer state of mind. For general relaxation, 1 hour costs IDR 219.000 per person; 1.5 hours (IDR 329.000) suits guests who prefer a slower treatment with more detailed pressure point work.

items.question: Can Shiatsu be combined with other spa treatments?
items.answer: Yes. Shiatsu is often combined with body treatments or other wellness services as part of a longer spa experience at Spa Bali Moon. Shiatsu itself runs 30 minutes (IDR 119.000), 1 hour (IDR 219.000) or 1.5 hours (IDR 329.000) per person. Message us on WhatsApp, 9am to 11pm, to plan your combination.

items.question: Is shiatsu massage painful?
items.answer: It should not be. Shiatsu massage at Spa Bali Moon can feel firm or intense when pressure is applied to tense areas, but it should remain comfortable. The therapist works at a controlled pace and can adjust the finger, thumb and palm pressure based on your preference, so tell them if anything feels too strong.

items.question: What is shiatsu massage good for?
items.answer: Shiatsu massage may help relieve muscle tension, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. It can also help improve flexibility and overall body comfort. At Spa Bali Moon it suits guests after work, travel or exercise, with focus on areas such as the neck and shoulders, back, hips and legs. Sessions start at IDR 119.000 per person.

items.question: When should you not do shiatsu massage?
items.answer: Shiatsu massage may not be suitable if you have certain medical conditions, injuries, or are recovering from surgery. If you are unsure whether it is right for you, consult a healthcare professional before your session. At Spa Bali Moon, tell your therapist about any health concerns first; pressure is always adjusted to your comfort.

items.question: How much does shiatsu massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: IDR 119.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 219.000 for 1 hour and IDR 329.000 for 1.5 hours per person at Spa Bali Moon. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist. You can pay by Visa, Mastercard or cash, and book your shiatsu massage on WhatsApp, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Is shiatsu the same as Japanese massage?
items.answer: At Spa Bali Moon, yes: our Japanese massage is shiatsu, the best-known Japanese massage technique. It is oil-free pressure-point work using fingers, thumbs and palms, with gentle stretching. Book it at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel for 30 minutes, 1 hour or 1.5 hours, from IDR 119.000 per person.
